Although the gameplay is good, there are a couple of bugs. For example, today I had 850 storage spaces and 247 coins. I bought an extra 50 storage spaces for 200 coins. The coins get subtracted, and the animation of +50 storage spaces does show, but when I go to my storage, the spaces are not added. Simular bug for pokemon limit and other items from the shop.

In their PvP battles, multiple times the other player gets their charged attack a second after they just used one, making me lose shields. This is obviously a glitch they haven't done anything about and is VERY annoying, because it makes me lose multiple battles to something that isn't fair. Their customer support is also non existent; they just refer you to articles. I've spent over $40 on this game. What a shame.

All the things added that make the game more accessible they have removed. They are making it more difficult for people with various accessibility issues to play. The shortened community days, the remote raid passes being raised in price and being limited makes it difficult for many people to play. I've decided to give it up after playing since launch because of this. They clearly don't care about their consumer base.

Have not been able to play in over 24 hours.... I've gotten as far as the loading screen and then I'm kicked out again. I've done everything you can to try and fix this. I've uninstalled the app, cleared the cache and data, restarted my phone, and reinstalled a million times with no change whatsoever. The only way you can contact support is in side the actual game and that's not possible if none of us are able to get in the app..... how are we getting any support? Are the even checking these?

Makers seem to be doing all they can to frustrate players. If they want to shut down tracking sites the least they could do is fix the in-game tracking first. Nobody likes wandering aimlessly for hours not being able to tell if they're getting closer to a rare Pokemon or not. Also the levelling up thing seems so poorly thought out it's unbelievable, player levelling up and training Pokemon. Won't be spending any more on in app purchases until Niantic start listening to and communicating with fans.

Not a lot of fun to be found 'hunting' pokemon unless you use a 3rd party app in tandem. The lack of variety of pokemon being found is turning me off the game very quickly. Until niantic sort out the hacks, cheats and spoofing, especially when it comes to gyms, this game is essentially tedious, boring and broken and completely ruined for genuine players.

Playing this game is like being in a toxic relationship, , it stresses you out but you can't leave because you've invested so much time into this. I re-downloaded pokemon go this year to be able to play with my brother who recently got into Pokemon, while the graphics and interface has been improved by a lot, it's become a curse due to the insane amount of glitches, bugs, and lag which is now quite normal in the game. Be it Avatars, GBL, or simply catching Pokemon. Niantic just doesn't care.

The core spirit of the game has been lost, it isn't Pokémon "Go" in the sense of go and explore your area and find cool things. It's go to the shop to buy incubator boxes and gamble to get something good. I have felt this way since they took most evolutions away from being wild spawns, made certain non-legends raid exclusive and made some wild spawns almost impossible to find.

If you don't live in a city or active community, you won't get the most out of this game. I was having a lot of fun with Pokemon Go when I first started playing. But over the last year, Niantic has been making changes that have been hindering the enjoyment I used to feel. As a rural player, remote raiding is the only way to get legendary Pokemon and Niantic has now limited raiding and more than doubled the cost of the item needed for it. The game is becoming very unfriendly to players as of late

Much has improved over the last couple of years. pvp, shiny/lucky 'mon, field/special research, raids, events... etc... still a long way to go than just button mashing but dev's are clearly focusing on the main aim of pokemon; battling 'mon against other trainers. Still plenty of bugs in game, eg; vanishing pokemon, caught pokemon changing, freezing, crashing, amongst others (don't get me started on adventure sync!!!) but a vast improvement and I'm happy playing again

For the most part, this game is great. It gets me and my kids out walking when the weather is nice. The gameplay is engaging. My only issue is the trading system, where we have 3-star Pokémon that you can evolve with a trade, and they are no longer 3-star after the trade. It's stupid and makes no sense. Anything less than 3 stars isn't worth keeping because the attack, defense, and hp stats are too low.

The game used to be fun and not so predatory, but it crashes often, freezes on loading, and prices have almost doubled for remote raids. Niantic could fix these issues but they refuse, instead introducing more buggy features like campfire and forcing players into in person raids, which unless you have a consistently playing close group of friends, will never happen. NO ONE goes to in person raids anymore.

Great game! I've been playing since it's release. New features are being added every now and then. And now with the pokestop submissions, we can add more stops/gyms on rural areas. The only downfall are the ingress players who approves the submissions thru OPR. They are less enthusiastic in approving stops or making a certain place a pokestop haven. Also, it would be cool if they could add skinhead avatars. :-)

Can you please give us an option to hide the "Raid Nearby!" and "X received Y items from your gift!" notifications? I'm can't connect my Go Plus, because the notifications cover the icon. I can't see my Pokemon's CP because the notifications block that. I cant's see how many coins I have, blocked by notifications. I'd like to open the app and start playing rather than opening the app and putting my phone down for 5 minutes once I agree to not trespass or play while driving...

It's a great game, but I do have a few problems. Sometimes I'll enter Pokémon Go and I'm not signed in, I try signing in and it says "Unable to authenticate" so I can't play. This jas happened to me many times, and I'm on my 2nd account because of this. I really hope this is fixed, it's a 5 star game if you fix this problem.

As much as I love this game I find it hard at the moment to keep up with playing. Being from a small town I don't have many pokestops close by and with the country in lockdown at the moment I am limited to when I can get out walking to play it. Is there anything that could be done to make this easier to play. As I have found myself missing out on events which is worrying after paying for my kanto event ticket

Pokemon was massive part of my childhood and I think most other kids. Technology has advance so much since pokemon red and blue come out and if my 10 year old self saw this I would be going crazy. But even now as an adult I find it very fun! Great for getting our and about. Already lost weight and even meeting up with friends just to walk around and play. The app itself is very good. Wish they work on them servers crashing but with every game it will keep developing. There is no other game like this out

I suggest that you should create a pokecenter in the game because not all the time we have potions, one thing is that potions are rare to get in stops, you could only a bunch of them when you leveled up but since it is not that easy to level up, our pokemon remain ill haha and remain unusable until we leveled up or find potions. I hope you read and think of this well.

After a couple years of playing from the start, my account mysteriously disappeared, with no response by Niantic. A few years later it reappeared and I've been playing almost daily since. But these new changes really screws me over. The active groups are located in a more central area far from mine. I don't speak the local language very much. There's little reason to continue despite the amount of money I've invested in the game. Way to ruin a market leading game. 😒

I managed to get into the game just fine but when I went to catch my first Pokémon, they were all in the same place and I was unable to catch any of them. I can't access the menu from this screen to report an issue or ask for help (that's what their website said to do when I went to try find help), I've restarted and reinstalled the game, I've emailed them (got an automatic response telling me to check the website) but I keep coming across the same issue.

I like the idea of this game better then I actually like it, its a stupid idea that you have to catch a million of each pkmn to level them up, some are impossible to find. Game is pretty boring, for the most part. Prefer the game boy versions much better. The creators could of done a much better job making a hybrid version between this game and the game boy version. Game works better now then it did before tho lots of bug fixes.

The game has a lot of potential, too bad there are a couple major problems. PVP is riddled with bugs and the developers are more interested in making money rather than making the game fun (see e.g. the recent mega evolution mechanic). Also you guys REALLY need to make the egg drop rates public. They are loot boxes for all intents and purposes, so not showing the drop rates is VERY shady (if not illegal).

Fun pokemon game. I like how the game let's you move, play with your pokemon, and have thrm venture with you. It also allows you to interact with people with the party option. Overall, it's a great game and I suggest you play it.

This game is really addictive! I've been playing for a few months since I got a new phone that is capable of running it. I just had a two week break from work and spent most of it walking around, catching Pokémon and participating in raids. It's motivating me to get out and exercise when I'd usually be sitting and using my computer all day. I've even met some new friends. Make sure you join your local raid group!! It's good to plan meetups for higher tier raids so you don't have too few people.

There are some nice elements, and the developers are always working to add new elements to the gameplay. Also kudos for the social aspects and encouraging physical activity. However, the application itself isn't very robust - often just sitting there spinning as though it has no connectivity, even though the network is fine. This usually requires a restart to resolve, which quickly becomes annoying.
game crashes every time I try to play with my Pokemon again... guess I can't walk it anymore. maybe fix your game
The Weekly challenge is broken. I can't claim the reward. The promo is superimposed with another prompt. Now I can't play the game. I've tried reinstalling and it's still stuck.

Love the game. However, I keep getting "Failed to Login" or "Unable to authenticate" errors for no sensible reason. Lately, only reinstalling the game seems to fix the problem, which is bad news whenever I'm on carrier data. The problem seems to affect only PTC accounts, but with my current progress, there's no way I'd create a new one using another service

It's good. Really! I love the sprites, and it's not really that hard to get item nowadays. The stickers are a great addition. Of course that's not without a flaw. Smh, after the updates, my game got glitchy like turning black everytime I transferred a Pokémon, or get stuck in a battle after I win or lose. It's really frustrating cus I need to restart the game each time. Other than that, great game!

Good fun to pass the time. Makes it easy to go outside and walk around. But everytime it has an update I have to uninstall and reinstall the game, because my updates always fail. Don't know why, but it's the only app that does this. Bugs just keep getting worse almost unplayable for me. Edit: This game now crashes everytime I play for more than 5 minutes. Pretty fun.

I really like the game and the idea behind it. Unfortunatelly, the game seems to never open on my phone :( It stays on the loading page until it fails or I give up. This happens with both Wi-Fi and 3G. Sometimes, after trying for a while, it will open. But it never lasts more than half an hour before it lags or crashes. I have a Moto G3 with Android 6.0 and 4GB of free memory, which is not that bad. Maybe someday the app won't be too heavy for my phone. But keep up with the good work guys :)

The normal game is alright, can become tedious at times, especially if you don't live in a large city. The biggest issue is the battle league. I can be in places with amazing Internet and it will still get stuck loading after preforming charged attacks or activating shields, and by the time its caught back up to itself the battle is as good as over. This constantly happens to opponents as well, as they will suddenly stop attacking and do nothing for the remainder of the battle.

Really fun but two huge flaws. The lack of a tracker system renders the 'Nearby' box pretty much useless, a frustrating taunting thing that will leave you walking helplessly in circles with no idea which direction leads you closer to your goal. Second, it crashes a lot. A LOT a lot a lot. As in, constantly. But I still keep playing. Curse you, addictive collecting instincts.

Fun but crashes more often than I would like it to. For example, after defeating a team rocket, the game just freezes and doesn't allow me to try to catch the dark pokemon and after restarting the game, it just goes back to the map. Another example is the game freezing right before a raid battle is about to start, allowing me to only look at the raid boss behind the gigantic 'GO'. One more thing, the pokestop stays blue even after I spin it.

Since the most recent update, no roads display. All areas are grass. My list of Pokémon always goes back to the top if I transfer, so I always lose my place. I love the game, but the glitches are so frustrating!!! Edit: this issue was resolved after uninstalling and re-installing. Edit: maps issue happening again with newest updates as well (even after uninstalling and re-installing).

For the last 3 years, I have tried to enjoy it. But it has become so stale. The combat system is really poorly set up. It requires no forethought. It's screen mashing, which was done better with Mario Party and its button mashing. Whoever thought this style was a good idea is an imbecile. It's close to being a decent game. But we need the moves, make us feel like we are having a battle. Not seeing who can poke their phone the most. There are too many negatives nowadays for 500 words.

This game is just amazing. So much hours of pure fun. I've noticed something that might be wrong, thought. May be some kind of bug that didn't disappeared with the last update. My brand new buddy (I mean, only one heart) is constantly popping up the notification that he found a present (I don't have the friendship level required for that). Also, I've noticed that my Charizard (Best buddy now) is not finding locations. It only happened once when I unlocked the features, and then never again.

I can't get back on once I turn off the app unless I use an actual wifi connection from like a house or something because my data won't work, and I've already tried useing a second acount but it won't work. I've also tried deleting and re-installing it but that didn't work either. Other than that love the game and would give it five stars. It's a little annoying when it crashes too but I haven't had much rouble with that. Keep up the great work👍:)

Ever since the latest update around September 24th I ha e been having terrible GPS issues! I have been booted out of raids because all of a sudden I am running all over the place. I also keep having issues battling at gyms and get an error code "29" that states the gym battle has already been won, when I'm only at the start or in the middle. I have tried uninstalling & reinstalling several times!!! This is extremely frustrating . Please fix these glitches Niantic

It's been 3 years and the login issue after losing your connection still has not been fixed. I have had 3 different phones and still get this problem. If I my internet connection goes down while playing, I have to reinstall the game to be able to login again. Or sometimes just randomly while trying to login it'll give me the "can't login" error. It also does that if you happen to type your password incorrectly. It is extremely annoying and just makes me not want to play at all.

Customer Support got a lot better! You now get to actually contact someone about problems (after clicking yourself through robot answers and the FAQ). They also fixed the most glaring errors in my opinion, which was that this app wouldn't work on Wifi on a lot of phones. However, if you only have limited data or a slow connection, you still can't log in on the go, which is a real issue for an app that is specifically designed to be used on the go.

I really thought Pokémon Go would live up to the reviews, and boy, was I wrong, and so were others. I just started playing the game, and when I try to catch my starter, it just doesn't even work! It just gets stuck on map view with all the starters and my character stuck in one spot while I rapidly to mash the "Catch a Pokémon" button. I searched up the bug to troubleshoot, and a lot more other people had the same error, with no avail. Saddening.

it's not bad. I still can't use it on a rooted device (which, by the way, is discrimination (look up the definition)), however on a crappy burner phone it works just fine, aside from the odd force close issue (that doesn't actually close the game. Adventure Sync is a feature that should have been in from day 1. I would rather be able to use it on my daily phone though.

Wanted to update my review. Played 6 years now and its way better than when they started this. I love how you brought down the nomination lvl to 37, events are super fun and I enjoy quests. Some bad things: I had to reinstall the game, cause I got an issue, and now I lost all my saved teams for gyms and battles. Can you make them Not-device saved but acc saved? Also, hairstyles, so many custom option except hairstile option. And I don't like that remote raid passes are only buyable now.

Great game overall. The gameplay is a bit buggy when the ball counts as a hit when it's hits air, others when it goes through the pokemon. There's also a bug where the character doesn't move while your walking, this happens alot everyday to both me and my friends. The controls are good, but can be annoying while trying to do a curveball throw, it resets the ball. Also I have experienced a curveball throw happening when I throw the ball straight forward without spinning the ball, causing the ball

There's been a definite improvement in the game since last year's big update. The addition of research tasks gives you an incentive to play daily, and the rewards are good. Even with that there are still plenty of bugs that can hinder progress, adventure sync seems to pick and choose when it wants to track steps and raid battles can be difficult since the timer will still count down even after you've beat a pokemon which can cause you to lose a battle you've already won.

After 2 years of come back after a series of updates and the game is in a much better place. There are still some balance updates that could be made, especially with the increase in available battles. It's worth playing, helps add a few extra steps on a walk so you can hit a few extra stops. Only real issue that remains is the crazy battery drain, but given it has to poll GPS and data semi-constantly I'm not sure that will ever change.

I like the game. The many updates of this last year are amazing, made me come back to the game after a little break. But infortunately adventure sync doesn't work with me. I have google fit installed and recording data but it is not syncing and sharing data with pokemon go. Everything is still at 0 and its been 3-4 weeks since it was released I think. Hope you can fix this problem. Thank you !

I honestly wish I found this game fun. Niantic has done a great job at adding new features that the community wanted, but nothing ever gets improved to where it needs to be. For example: The battle system is boring, clunky and has no strategy. Trading is so held back by stardust requirements that I hardly do it, I've never seen a raid in my city with a more than a couple people and I've been aying for years. These problems aren't super hard to fix, but they make the game really hard to enjoy.

At the moment it's not working properly. The first few minutes work fine when I go in. Though once I go to my friend list for example I can't exit the game. If I do anything else like spin a pokestop the map freezes but my character keeps moving. I have to keep restarting my phone every time the game doesn't work. It's been like this since the game updated to the new version last night.

Very good app. i would give it five but it crashes after it loads up, that is not a bad problem, the main problem is it lags like mad on my acatel one i'm pretty sure it is not my storage as it is 16 GB. I have a second one which is 8 GB one and it has the same problem. lagging all of the time. i recommend that you do not play on an acatel as it is really laggy but it could be the app

This game has made me walk way more than I used to! While I like the gameplay in general, it has serious usability shortcomings (even bugs) in the friends list and in showing (=not showing) Pokémons' game stats. I hope they'll pay more attention to the usability issues. It's a fun game and makes people talk on the street with each other, that's a good thing :-)

So, I really like Pokemon GO. I love how it pretty much makes another boring day out walking fun; it just gives you something to do. However, I have two issues. Firstly, I do not like the egg system. It's a glorified Loot Box system that either needs to be changed or removed. Loading times are also still a big issue since he games launch. I really like the game, but there are issues that need to be fixed.

This is a regular game. But I wouldn't recommend it to anyone. Bugs everywhere and every time, an unfair system for players around the world. While in USA you can find a lot of poke stops, almost in every town or city, in other countries barely one for towns. PVP with 'weak connection' issue makes the worst system for a game. If I could, I rate it zero stars.

Still very glitchy in parts. Most of them dont really affect game play too much. But its still lagging too much when im trying to send gifts. And when i go in to look at my eggs, the screen 'splits' with another page on the way out. Its very annoying and i need to keep rebooting the app to fix it. However on the whole the app is excellent and is now a big part of my lifestyle.

Awesome game, love it, its really great for if you want to move more! But I have one problem with it, the limits on the inventory and pokemons, it's not fun to do anything if you they get full, you can't really do anything either except delete, I have a problem on the inventory limit especially, I can't collect anything and there's too much important stuff that I can't delete and it's making me not want to play and move anymore which I desperately need. I hope the limit at least goes higher!

The app doesn't register the distance travelled. I walked from house to morrisons and back which was ~2km and no progress has been made. The app has been open the entire time. Registered I walked 2.8km but no progress has been made to eggs in incubators or with buddy. It's also impossible for me to turn on Adventure Sync. I just go through the same process repeatedly, it keeps telling me to "turn it on in settings" which I have been doing! Coms with developers is hard. Their email doesn't work.

Decent game in general with nostalgic. More and more features are added to this one of the best free games. The biggest problem is go battle league. The ideas are great yet the server is terrible since day one. Half of the time during battles, I've encountered go battle lag or opponent sneak in a fast move and my wifi is very good. I know the game made a lot of money and we still play the game even how bad the server is. Just because we're playing won't justify the never resolved server issues.

Communities are often the worst part of a Fandom. This game isn't perfect, but it is amazing! Being able to catch pokemon while walking my dog, take pictures of them in the real world, partying up with friends and catching shinies is amazing! Most of the negative reviews are bots or kids with the attention span of a slowpoke. I have loved Pokémon since Gen 1, and any true fans of Pokémon still enjoy this game to this day! The others can go back to Fortnite.

Really enjoying this game. It's a little buggy and lacks variety, but it has a compelling gameplay loop. Microtransactions could be rebalanced slightly in order to seem less predatory and to encourage exercise, incubators being the main culprit. PSA: if you cannot connect to let's go on your switch, TRY REMOVING THE JOYCONS. I have no idea why, but this seems to work.

A very nice idea but very poorly executed. Many unsolved bugs such as GPS issues, steps not counted, crashing etc... Instead of focusing on optimizing the game, the focus seems mostly on simply adding more Pokémon generations and in game purchases. It's very unbalanced for people who have little time to play this. Very disappointing, it could have so much potential.

The game is quite good. Great development, however when getting inside to the (Ar mode) to catch some pokemon. It seems like to catch the pokemon, the phone needs to be near the eyes. Since if it is far, it is hard to catch, also the payment is a bug, since to get 100 pokecoins is 5000, while to get 550 is 75,000, the diffrence is so big. So that is why i give it as a 3 star..... 😭😭😭

The game itself is amazing. The developers work on it and update the app frequently, adding more fun content. However one of the main components of the game needs a lot of work: the GPS aspect. As a game that relies heavily on that, the GPS function should work as flawlessly as possible, which is clearly not the case. Please improve the GPS function. Whenever I close the app (but it still runs in the background) and I re-open it, nothing loads anymore and I have to completely restart the app.

Started to play again and it can be quite addictive! I can see why it does get people to go out to walk&explore more. The only issue I have been encountering is that suddenly the app doesn't allow me to login. I tried closing the app & restarting and clearing my cache out.. The only temporary solution I've found is deleting the app and reinstalling.. but it will bound to happen again at some point.. :/

This is a game full of bugs. In the battle league, i am already taking damage, before the timer even gets to zero. I could have flawless reception. In a battle where timing is everything, how can you win, if you're taking damage, before you even start. I contacted help and they blame you and your device. I have no other issues in other games. Also, it shows you have a pending gift, when you dont. It shows you have a new task, when you dont. I will not be a paying player, until its resolved.

It's a great game, and I've loved it for years. But again, I've just had to uninstall it due to the ridiculous battery consumption. My phone normally lasts 2 days but with Pokémon GO installed, its lasting 8 hours or so. Pretty sure it's the live GPS it constantly uses but I couldn't find any settings for this within the app. If you can stop the application using the phone's resources whilst closed, I'd happily download again.

Game is great when it works, and runs smoothly. Gets easily overworked and begins to bug out. Summers been none stop for outings, and raids, can't complain. Only complaints being every time I need an update (Which is becoming very often now) I can't update straightaway, always an error. I have to delete my whole app, redownload and start over again. Please fix this!

I used to love this game, recently reinstalled it a couple weeks back as I had enough storage space. Been really enjoying it (minus the OP bosses, that are just there to consume all my items). However, as of past 24 hours I was logged out and unable to log back in. I uninstalled and reinstalled it several times, as well as following the instructions on the support online. But nothing has fixed it. Incredibly annoying as I want to play this game but can't. Not to mention I've wasted money on it.

I love this game. I've been playing basically since release day, off and on, and I love it entirely. However the most recent update on the 16th or 17th has pretty much destroyed the ability to play it. I've never had lag with previous updates but I do now, and its made catching and battling pretty much a hit and miss type issue. Honestly likely to avoid the game till its fixed. EDIT: Curveballs have also been totally and utterly ruined by this update.

Suggestion: In-game Appraisal should have option for Simple and Advanced. Simple being verbal interpretation only (as it is now) and Advanced being numerical data for exact interpretation. I don't want to interpret what "decent", "strong", etc means. I want exact numerical figures for the 3 IVs :) Overall, awesome game! Battle should be improved, but I know you already know that.

every so often I get signed out of my account and I cant sign back in. its gives me an error message saying unable to authenticate, my username and password hasn't changed either so I dont know what the problem is. this needs to be fixed. it happens too often (EDIT) It's been way over a week now since I emailed support regarding the trouble I've been experiencing, and I still haven't heard anything back. I'm so disappointed so I'm switching from 3 to 1 star rating. I'd give it a 0 if I could.

From first playing in 2018 and before pandemic seem to be the best times I've had on the app. Since then it's become a clear cash grab with microtransations almost becoming a necessity if you want to be a part of the community, especially if you live in a remote area. I want to keep using the app but the item limitations, item prices and daily coin limits are just not matching up and it's becoming a slog to play instead of fun anymore. Disappointed and frustrated at what used to be a good time.

Pokemon Go is an amazing app for all kinds of people from the outdoorsy to die hard fans of the series to those like myself using it as a tool to overcome anxiety and go outdoors more. I rate it 4/5 because it can be difficult to play without mobile data or unlimited WiFi (lagging, freezing, slow loadtimes, repeated errors make a few common annoyances) as well as the amount of storage space needed and difficulties downloading updates. Fully recommend to all, though be aware of above limitations.

First of all the game is fun when it works. However, that seems to be less and less the case. With the updates, the old server problems are back, and the game also crashes a lot more, making it nearly unplayable on slightly older devices. Half the time you are fighting some kind of technical issue, which really gets old quickly. And now they have stopped refunding coins if you have technical issues, which is just ridiculous. Avoid until they fix this. Update: they did not, today they were found lying again, and they will do nothing about it.

The game is just perfect! But it would have been better if it came with option to use it either with a joy stick or normal movement. I can't move here and there all the time to play this game. So, if you can, provide an inbuilt joy stick for movements and after it, providing bikes for fast travelling would be great which we would control with the given joystick. Try it and believe me this wonderful game would get millions of more users.

The game started off with plenty of potential for greatness, just as long as the servers were fixed along with a few small bugs. Within probably a week, the main element of the game (a tracker for actually being able to find the pokemon) was broken. Now another two weeks on, instead of fixing it, they remove it completely and take down any third party sites which were around to fix the issue of the tracker not working. Not worth playing without a tracker!

This game is awesome if you need an excuse to go outside or struggle with that due to mental health problems. I do have problems with the purchasing items with real money though. Once I try to purchase something, it always fails and the item I tried to purchase will always disappear forever. Purchasing items is optional though, which is a relief. The occasional shiny Pokemon are always exiting, even if it's a duplicate Starly.

Update: The focus on battling and the increased prices for some of the more fun aspects like remote raiding so I could play with friends in other states/countries means I almost never play anymore. Original: Even with the server issues this is a great game. Obviously no one could have planned for just how insanely popular this would be. It's an honest free to play that doesn't limit you if you don't spend real money and let's you fast track if you do. A great and fun app!

The changes introduced in the pandemic made the game better, and now not only have they rolled back in many of those changes, but their making the game less accessible by increasing the cost of remote raids and limiting them. As someone who has time constraints due to life and obligations, the remote passes made it possible for me to raid. I for one am going to be quiting the game, enough is enough, Niantic has ruined a good thing.

It's a lot better than it was, but there is still 0 consideration for rural players. If you don't live near a city center, you'll have a pretty boring time, and the raid boss feature will be more or less unplayable. Other than that, it's fun and a great way to get me out and exercising. New features are more regular now and are by and large pretty useful, it's like the developers actually care about the playerbase after 2 years of neglect. If this game now was the release version 2 years ago, it would be astonishing.

A fun game however, every time I try to log in, it says unable to authenticate, and I'll have to change my password. Itll work, then the next day, same thing, and I'll have to change it again. I've changed it so many times now, this needs to be fixed. I always type in my pass right but it keeps happening, please fix! Also, it also shows gps error 11 quite a lot, even when I'm somewhere with excellent connection..

PoGo has continued to improve and add some QoL features, gameplay, and social function, which help make it fun. It still sucks that if you pay for items you also have to pay for space to hold them, but they've opted for money over usability here. More automated/configurable features to manage pokes and inventory would be great, but they won't add them because they want you buying more storage! I look forward to upcoming social features.

Current review: Fun and improved so much. Play it with my son and we have very little issues with bugs etc. It is a good way to pass time =) 2016 review: A pointless game without tracking system, internal or 3rd party otherwise. Now nice, great and excellent throws don't even give extra exp..? Horrendous way to update a game without advance notice and also terrible gym system.

Fantastical magical experience. Really enjoy this game but recently the game has been randomly canceling out and going to my home screen while in the middle of a battle. Getting really bad now cuts out half way through battles, also freezes in raids and shadow stops. Update still having clitches have had to delete game and re download it again about 5 times now. Getting really sick of the game which is a shame because I have invested quite a bit of money and time, going to delete soon for good.

Really enjoy this game and have for 6 years. But as of the 6th of April, the game will not be played often or is uninstalled. Mainly due to a price increase that is almost double on selected instore items (remote passes), also limiting remote raids I feel is a step back. The game has changed since covid and niantic needs to embrace it, not change it. But I suppose making you get out and walk makes them money as they do sell the data collected. What's more important? Definitely not the user!

I only have trouble with the routes: they are not completed because I'm "missing meters" or something like that. But to me, it's the first game I ever got addicted to. The different approaches allow you to choose your goals (wether it's tasks, gyms, Pokédex, medals, battling, perfect-iv-pokemons, coins, shinies!) so it's never boring because there's always something you can pursue.

Been playing since release. A fun way to kill time when walking or taking transit...when it works. Unable to launch/log in more often than I can, which constantly kills my streaks. It never fails to pester me with notifications even though it won't let me play, though! Bought a Pokéball Plus on Boxing Day and haven't been able to try it yet.

The game is constantly getting better. Not fast, but constantly. It is still a bit of a grind, but with access to more Pokemon's, more gyms, more events, more everything, and the Adventure Sync feature to compensate for the app's crappy GPS, I have fun again. Having a Go Plus accessory also makes a large difference in quality of life, fun and access to more 'mons and options.

It is a fun game to play casually with friends and collect pokemon as if they are stickers, but if you like a more complex game that values the battling aspect of it and your connection with you pokemon, just stick to the games from the original franchise. I have played the game since it's beginning, with a few pauses. It was a simple but fun game. However, in the past few months the developers took a hard turn on the cash grabbing aspect of it. The only new mechanics are thought out with the specific purpose of taking money from you, bugs are endless and they do not bother to solve them (unless it gets in the way of them getting more money, of course). Another point that bothered me is that they have no late game content. A person who has been playing for 4 years will be able to accomplish the same as someone who has been in the game for a month, and that aspect got worse now with them making the pvp system a "participate and win", instead of having to actually be good at it to get to higher ranks.

Nice to play, except when it either randomly closes, randomly freezes, or randomly decides to reboot my phone, not to mention the heaps of bugs that have been here since launch. You'd think two years and millions in sales would be enough for a software company to fix their bugs, but I guess making a game properly is too much to ask. Everyone I know who're playing this have the same issues as me, so it's not an isolated case. Also, with all the millions in sales, you'd expect the servers to be somewhat decent, but no. Somehow they still haven't set up servers that can handle the amount of traffic from 10 million users, even though they have a concrete number of the peak amount of users to expect. TL;DR: Thanks Niantic, you've made a game with barely any gameplay and loads of bugs and performance issues that you haven't been able to fix after two years. EDIT: Also, why is the cheapest coin pack also the cheapest per coin? None of your actions make sense Niantic!

Used to be a great game; I've been playing since July 2016. Now it freezes randomly while playing, often more than once per session, and is necessary to restart to continue. It lags a lot. And with the reduction in remote raids plus the huge price increase for remote raid passes that can only be acquired by buying them, I am already looking for a new game to play.

Potential, but not quite there. At first, it was very very buggy. Customer service was (is?) non-existent. Today, it's ok and I do enjoy playing from time to time. Problems with it are more of its technological choises. Before the adventure sync just wasn't working. Now it seems to be working, but it drains your phones battery very quickly. One app with background use with 6% battery in under 1,5h is not acceptable.

The game is good enough a bit pay to win of late, but I'd love to be able to get rid of stickers, I appreciate they don't take up space in the bag that doesn't mean I want to keep all of them though. I think it would be cool to offer a suggestion box. Also would have loved for that level 40 medal to have been not limited time, especially since covid restrictions have limited a number players ability to play.

This could be great, and aside from server issues it was, on launch. But since then the developer has seemingly been removing key gameplay features from the game, such as tracking via distance. If Niantic bring tracking back I might have reason again to head outside specifically to play, but as it stands this is now something I just peer at from my desk, as I've no hopes of finding anything deliberately. Edit: well, it now has a feature it should have had since launch; you now don't need the app open and active to track walking.

Uninstalling after 3 years of re-installing. I just noticed pay walled events getting more frequent and expensive as time goes by. Missing the simple times when PoGo just launched. Also, as new features get introduced, the interface gets a bit too laggy. Too many going on, I guess. So, yeah. I imagine the game's gonna be heavily pay walled in just a few years. But it was fun 'til it lasted.

*update* 13/09 after around 4 years of playing ive decided to take a break. The game is weighted so heavily around raids now that the only way to keep up is to spend cash on passes. Ive lost the love for playing. Niantic if you read this please think about putting in more challenges or story mode types quests that allow you unlock more passes. Its insane how much you have to spend to keep up! Not good in the current climate (Covid-19)

Really good game, but... I've been experiencing a lot of issues when it comes to network changes. Whether it is because of my phone losing connection because of bad signal or sometimes just connecting to a WiFi network, the game stops recognizing my account; even after trying to log in again it just won't work. I have to uninstall and reinstall it again every time this happens (about twice a week) Please fix this as soon as possible, it's kind of annoying.

This is a great AR game and a good challenging activity for a group of like minded friends. I would have kept my rating at 5, but for almost a year now I've watched as my game gets needlessly stuck at 75% loading in title screen Every. Single. Day. It will usually take about 4 force quits and reopen to get the app finally running. It's shameful that this is a known issue and for so long. Definitely should be addressed by now.

Love the game but today's update has broken it. The battle mode just doesn't work. At all. And if I manage to finally get into a battle my Pokémon just sits there unresponsive and dying. I've reinstalled and cleared cache still it doesn't work. It's not quite juddery. Constant freezing and crashing. It's suddenly unplayable at the moment. Note 9 with all latest updates.

Lots of crashes lately. I don't know what's going wrong lately but more often than not, I will get daily crashes and the app will get stuck on the initial load screen. Having to close it and re open to get it to work. It will also regularly crash when catching a Pokemon. I'll throw a ball, shakes say once or twice. Frozen. Did I catch it or not? It used to run fine with zero issues but these latest updates seem to have caused more harm than good. Will update my review when the game gets sorted.

It's a good game but I still have problems with it freezing. You do need WiFi or data to play this though. I do however wish there was an offline mode so I can get my steps done without the game freezing because I don't have Internet or extra data for it to use. It makes it very hard to hatch eggs when the program constantly freezes and then doesn't want to boot back up because there's no WiFi connection. The other suggestion I have is maybe have a way to input your steps when you open the game. I'm tired of it freezing every time it has no connection.

I've been playing this game for 5 years now and it's good fun for what it does. Best location based game. It will appeal most to collectors. The PVP side of things is not fun , it turns the turn-based strategy of main series pokemon battles into a real-time quick reaction game with lots of tapping. The game design of this bit feels like something that might have come out of the megadrive/SNES era, and not in a good way. Heavy "pay to win" to get shiny legendaries. Eggs are loot crates.

Although I am giving a one star review on this game, I would like to say that I personally love playing the game. My problem however, comes from the lack of support for players being affected by bugs. For example, I have recently run into an issue where I had just gotten my ursaring back from defending a gym for my team. When i had received a notification that my pokemon had returned with fifty coins. Excitedly i opened the shop happy to finally get the bag upgrade I've wanted for the past while, only to noticed i received no coins what so ever. I then went to the "support page" of pokemon go to see if others had the same problem which as it seems, others have also not received the coins they were supposed to be given. At the bottom of the page when viewing the details of the bug the developers inadvertently called people making the claim liars by stating they could not recreate the bug themselves, and therefore because it didn't happen to them whole defending a gym it was impossible that it happened to anyone else. I then decided to report the bug myself, only wanting an answer to why the glitch had happened, rather than the coins only to notice that I needed to confirm that I accept that I am not going to receive a reply blfrom anyone. If any of the developers are reading my review than please do respond to this review, just to explain why the glitch occurred if there is any information as to why it happened. I would then gladly change my review to five stars, because I still do absolutely love playing pokemon go.

You don't end up stopping cheaters but you do discourage rule-abiding players. Many commuters used to check pokestops in bus or so - this is without any speed-related risk - and now this too is a good point of this game of the past. I do appreciate the recent addition of many spawn points and upcoming new features such as purported Ditto. After playing for a week, and investing in the go plus accessory, I think I've played enough to write a review. I want to say that I haven't played a pokemon game since the gameboy advance, and Go has advanced just as far as my knowledge goes, so I'm comfortable with the Pokemon available. I find the game to be a good incentive for a large person like myself to get out of the house and walk around. Even after 500+ catches, catching a new Pokemon still feels satisfying. The gym battles are alright, and the raids are cool too, but good luck finding partners. My biggest gripe with the game is the go plus's inability to stay connected. In an 8 hour shift, I had to stop and reconnect it 11 times. It gave no warning of disconnecting. My other issue with it is that the distances traveled is COMPLETELY inaccurate. It seems like you need to travel a significant distance in a certain direction before it even begins to count as distance. There's also no reason that the go plus shouldn't work while driving. It's a button on the wrist of a hand you have on the wheel. Pressing it is less distracting than changing the radio station. As of right now, the go plus is much too unreliable to make it worth purchasing and I'm considering returning it. Besides the disconnection issue and the fact that I can walk down the road and not register that last 0.1 km i need on an egg, it's a super fun game. Edit: my go plus disconnected while I was typing this review. Edit: it's been a couple of months and I feel this needs an update. Pokemon Go is awesome. It can link with Google fit, and tracks your steps that way, so egg hatching is actually based on how much you walk instead of some arbitrary gps movement. The Go plus still disconnects constantly, but its consistent now, down to the hour. Apparently this is to save battery. Regardless, the game is constantly improving.

A very well designed game from Niantic. Not without its initial hiccups and slow drip feed of content, but most of that seems to have been ironed out. The constant addition of new and interesting events is usually topped off with new pokemon releases 1-2 times a year. The community day events are a blast, albeit inconvenient with their short time frames, and prove that the game enjoys steady success even after the hype died down. The only real issue I take with the game are its laggy UI on my Galaxy S7 Edge, and some controls such as the capture mechanics downright refusing to work sometimes. Overall a pretty enjoyable game, and I'd recommend it to anyone looking for a time waster or for anyone that's a long time fan of the series.

Yes, the servers need work but that is to be expected honestly. To those who think money is the only way the evolve your pokemon, not true. super fun educational ish about Pokemon every pokémon that exists is in this game the ones that are not in the game has not came out yet five stars wish could rate better

Look, the additional body options for our avatars was a neat idea on paper- but holy hell did this backfire. The models look terrible for one. the game is wonderful!, that brings Pokemon to reality! but it is a bit boring while catching wild pokemons by only feeding barries and throwing pokeballs. it's my humble request to please integrate the feature of fighting wild pokemons with our existing pokemons, making them weaker and then catching them with Pokeballs, just as happens in the anime. this will make the game even more interesting

The game is pretty cool with a slick UI and fairly balanced Pokémon spawns... but the battling system has no strategy to it. Just tap and pray... fun :/. This review is aimed at us older players. This game is tons of fun, alone or as a social activity. Great for battling couch potato syndrome. So many aspects that cater to your particular form of fun. I like collecting Pokemon and connecting with people around the world (using Reddit) in my friends list. Very upbeat.

Great game for catching your favorite pokemon on the go, but if you want to earn coins or expand your bag. You are going to need to cough up a lot money or be good a defending gyms. Side quests range from easy to literally impossible for mostly terrible rewards. If they are going to put every pokemon in the game, they should give you storage for that free of charge.

Why are the "wild" pokemon in heavily populated areas? It's like the Pokemon are backwards. 4 star for couple reasons. I love pokemon, this game is a way to be active. Pokestops give little Items. Increase amount of items gained when rank increases plz. Game is good, if not just a little two dimensional. You spend hours catching pokemon from across nearly every generation. You have the opportunity to evolve them, and battle them in numerous ways. The problem is that the process becomes repetitive after a while. Catch, collect candies, transfer, evolve, repeat. Big payoffs like finding those hard to spot pokemon are far and few unless you really dig in 10+ hours a week. If you're a pokefan you may be better off playing pokemon on DS or switch.

Some suggestions. 1. Player can add a status message that friends can see. 2. Don't show friends to be selected for raid battles if the friend is too far away and does not have a remote raid pass. 3. Allow the option to remove duplicate postcards from same location. This will help a player to manage postcard book. 4. Allow remote trading. If we can raid remotely then why not remote trade. All friends I have made so far are from other country but I can't trade with them at all.

After the recent update, I am no longer able to play for the majority of the day. A red error banner is at the top of my screen that reads, "GPS signal not found. Error 11." I have tried everything to fix this and have been unsuccessful. Went from using the app all day, to maybe 10-15 minutes. Would really like to see this fixed.

Amazing, immersive, and fun Edit for drop in rating: the game is still immensely fun, but Niantic support is a nightmare to deal with. The support department was entirely unhelpful and did not help me fix my issue at all. They closed my issue without it being resolved. The game is fun, but the actual people running it aren't reliable assistance.

Getting worse each update. The game is ok when it works, but it's getting much more unstable in go battle league, and the prices are getting worse. It's pretty much impossible to get enough relevant mons to battle in master league unless you whale out and spend a ton on the recently increased in price raid passes. Also, the models look gross now.

Probably still the best mobile game ever released. A must-have for Pokémon fans, particularly the ones obsessed with collecting for Pokédex completion. The combat could be better, but it is entertaining and functional. It is a "grindy" game, for sure; but it can still be fun, even for new players early on.

A fun, casual, and highly streamlined Pokémon game. Combat is not turn-based, and amounts to tapping and occasionally swiping the screen. Pokémon only have 2 abilities each. Changing the abilities is mostly random. My biggest complaint is raid invites being delayed past the deadline of accepting them--sometimes by several hours--if I get the invites at all.

Used to love Pokemon GO and would play it nearly daily, but the recent increase in price for remote passes and the limitation of remote raids has made it impossible for me to continue. I live in a rural town with no real community, so we barely get any raids here, and playing remotely was the only way I could actually keep up with other players who live in cities. Super disappointing from Niantic.

I was one of the few that had this game since the very beginning when they first released it. I have to say that they really improved it over the years. It used to be so laggy and there were very few Pokemon, but now there are Pokemon everywhere. It isn't laggy. Loading time is short. This game has since improved greatly and I absolutely love it now!

I wish the developers were avid players. I love the game, in deep a few years now. There are just certain features that would be easy to implement and yet completely overlooked by designers. Specific items with capped inventory, revive/heal all, or ability to accept/reject an egg from a spin are some examples.

After this stupid pandemic started, Niantic got busy at work. (which I should've guessed they already were, adding hundreds of pokemon and all) And they've made it very enjoyable while outside and inside! I'm super happy with how the game is right now and I've gotta say, in these past few months my respect for Niantoc has gone up. Thank you! P.S. I haven't run into the "failed to login" game-breaking bug in quite some time. I think it's gone, thanks Niantic! I really recommend this game!

Other than that, I have no major complaints. The more friends you have who play, the easier it is to aquire loot through sending each other daily gifts. People need to stop blaming for awhile because of all these hate message .... This is probably one of the healthiest game I have ever played. Not only it is healthy, it is fun. The most notable issue is the recurring Failed to Login prompt, after which your only option is to Clear App Data and hopefully you remembered your password because it clears all of your settings including credentials. Another is it now seems to require a rather high end phone as the Nexus 5X only barely runs the more recent updates. The 5X's 2GB RAM won't let you multitask between any other applications while playing the game (it used to) and most likely filters down to the other recent issues like unreliable Pokemon GO Plus connections and constant 'GPS Signal Not Found' errors, meanwhile it's sunny outside and Google maps and U-Blox have no satellite locking issues.

It's super fun, but the limit on items you can have in your bag is really low. (I know you can buy more space, but it takes forever to gather the coins). Money grab on nostalgia. There are so many things wrong with this game its insane! For one customer service is non-existent. I love this game. My only problems are that due to living in a rural area, the level 5 raids are extremely difficult, the lack of pokestops makes completing certain tasks nearly impossible without traveling a minimum of 45 minutes, and the difficulty of catching the new pokemon due to low spawns.

Love this app but some of the milestones are a bit unrealistic. For example: in a single week, the top goal is to walk 50km or 30mi. In what world do people walk 30 miles? More realistic goals would be 2km for the first, 5km for the second, and 10km for the third. I have a walking impediment. Your current walking goal rewards are unattainable for someone like me. I don't like the new appraisal system. I preferred the percentages given by the third party apps. The new system just seems basic.

Long time player, but I think I've had enough. The final straw won't be the constant GBL issues, raid glitches, or atrocious box and pass pricing. It's the constant connection issues that will do it for me. I've missed countless raids, spotlight hours, and community days jumping through hoops to try to get the app to load. Between the unpaid labor of wayfarer submissions and the hours of struggling to load the game, only to have a glitch force a restart as soon as a raid pops, I'm fed up.

Great game overall, but lately with the new daily incenses I've noticed that I'll throw a pokeball it'll shake once, maybe twice and the pokemon will break free and just run immediately afterwards. To start off this game is epic when it works right. Now working right is extremely rare. Stuck boot screen, constant freezing during the game, glitchy graphics due to being bogged down. Really good keeps me busy while traveling. I don't like how we have to walk everywhere it's not like we can all walk to work or anything. Extremely difficult to look feminine as well, the shoulders are broad and the hips get weird if you try to have any. All avatars are manly.

Little things like that. But other than that I very much enjoy the game.

As a long time player I feel like I can get some mileage just from the sheer fact I haven't missed too many events. The game is just going downhill incredibly fast. I feel like the developers released pokémon way too fast and they're freaking out because they don't know how to innovate. Sticking to their "mission" I feel is just ruining the game. Accommodating multiple types of players is more inclusive to a community. I really hope they start to listen to the feedback.

A wave of pokemon nostalgia. A dream come true for many. The ability to collect your very own pokemon. Although, the game has a few shortcomings. There are many incentives to pay for items, but the game is still possible without spending a dime. Edit - down from 4 to 3 stars. PvP aspect of the game is extremely buggy. I've been playing for a while and overall the game is good, but after a while the only interesting thing remaining for me is events where we get new Pokemon or increased chances of catching shiny Pokemon. Otherwise the game becomes repetitive. There's very little point doing more than one gym battle, the rewards from battle league are unimpressive now and even many of the events and research tasks are repeating themselves or not interesting. I certainly wouldn't spend money on this app again.

I love this game. Things I hope to see in the future are: Rare bottlecaps to raise pokemon IVs! Please! Ability to evolve event pokemon (with a warning that they will lose their event cosmetic). New hairstyles for player models! (Though I wish they would do an overhaul on the player model to look more like pokemon characters. The player model looks very strange.) I love this game so much and can't wait to see what the future has in store!

I am changing my rating to one star. I am a player in a rural area who plays with a disabled person that made heavy use of the incense and pokestop distance boosts. Now they won't be able to play and without them I have no incentive to continue either. The changes were positive and inclusive. Now it is back to the same old garbage that makes it largely unplayable for rural and disabled players. I won't miss this game, but I will miss the time spent with family while playing it.

I would have to say that originally when I first downloaded this game it was amazing then after each update the app got worse until I was unable to play because of server issues after hours of continuous repeated log ins and reinstalls not to mention the hundreds of dollars wasted on Pokemon Gofest tickets, hotel costs, gas and almost 12 hours of total drive time to get nothing other than stress and frustration. Don't play this game, just dont. It relies so heavily on random chance to get garbage items to evolve worthless pokemon and its unexceptable! I think there should be a battle system for catching pokemon. There should also be proper stats such as attack, special attack, and speed modifiers. This game really lets me down in those aspects. There should be a way for player outside of time zone events to get those rewards. Its not fair to miss rewards because one sleeps at night and misses rewarded events.

A long time coming, but if you live in a populous area Pokemon Go is well worth a play now. The biggest difference is the transparency regarding Pokemon stats. It lists 3 star quality of your pokemon and where their strengths lie. It allows you to easily sort and curate your collection, and figure out which pokemon are worth spending time upgrading. This motivates walking with buddies, which encourages pokestop visiting and collecting. Its simple, but fun, finally. Combat is more involved too.

Really fun game, I like the candy and catching systems. It's a nice change in Pokémon games. Although, I wish there was a lite mode for the game, other than battery saver. The game crashes for me at all the wrong times. Whether that's a gym, trainer, or rocket battle. I end up losing items because of it. The game also takes up a lot of my RAM. It's hard to play with all the limitations it gives me.

Game is too tedious, and rng based. Can't play competitively at the highest key without cheating. Can't play without traveling far distances, and doesn't reward players for playing in harsh weather. Because they don't want to hinder The Pokémon Company's & Gamefreak's sales and profits. By making a better game that's is also free to play.

Look, this game is enjoyable BUT needs a major, major update. It is looooooong overdue and I wish Niantic cared more about players. Firstly, there is a fair amount of hackers in this game but they like to deny it. Play the game and you'll see what I mean. Secondly, the UI, the sounds/music, and character designs are just... outdated and glitchy. It is just not refined, a franchise like Pokémon deserves better. Lastly, the devs are becoming more greedy by the update.

Rather than creating new innovative features that actually incentivize players to "explore" the world, Niantic is alienating players by heightening the pay wall to already basic features. In the days of Google and Amazon, I don't care about what Niantic does with my data, but these new restrictions to gameplay make the game much less enjoyable. Despite having a multi-billion dollar IP in its hands, Niantic still does not care for its player base and is only in it for the money...

BRING BACK THE FREE REMOTE RAID PASSES. PROVIDE MORE EGG INCUBATORS. These items make the game much more enjoyable and exciting. It just seems like a money grab that these items can only be purchased. Also, you should get XP every time you make a nice/great/excellent throw, regardless of if the pokemon gets caught or not. You still made a nice/great/excellent throw even if the pokemon breaks out, and you should get the XP for that. It makes no sense why this isn't a feature.

Up until recently, I've been mostly happy with the game. Its been a nice little reconnection to my childhood and the happiness I had playing the original pokemon games. And I've been willing to over look many things I have issues with regarding the game (one such thing being the fact that Wilmer requires 400 candy to evolve for very little pay off. A 1280 Wilmer only bumped to a 1992 Wailord) but the Sinnoh Stones being required for the added gen 4 evolutions and only being able to be acquired by a random chance for a 7 DAY RESEARCH is ridiculous, especially considering when they where first announced, literally everything I saw said it was supposed to be guaranteed, is what really dropped my love for the game. I dont really get the chance to compete research quests, it usually takes me the better part of a month to get all 7 days completed. Heck, I only just managed to get my Mew 2 days ago. Normally I have nothing against rng, it's part of any good game, and with the other evolution required items I didnt have an issue because the 7 day spin streak is something that is usually within my grasp due to the fact that the stops are everywhere and a simple reminder in the phone can help you hit 1 a day. But when it comes to the research quests (which themselves I have nothing against and really love the idea of), they can be tedious and time consuming to complete 1 in the run of a day, let alone getting 7 that are easy enough to get done in 7 days. Yeah, part of that is just the bad rng I have because I tend to get the ridiculous ones that take time for me to complete, and having to delete and respin stops gets tedious and old super quick. As I said, up until the Sinnoh Stones, I've been happy to have nostalgia blinders on and overlook things that I might not like about the game, and for the most part, I've really enjoyed the game. But I'd really like to be able to have some of my favorite gen 4's without feeling like I'm being forced to jump through a 4 inch diameter ring into a small glass of water.

I've been a Pokémon fan from childhood, as many of us are, so this game had me excited. This game has a great idea and lots of potential, however it's executed poorly. They've only just implemented battling with your friends, but you have to play with them and raise your friendship status to be able to do so. What happened to "if we lock eye contact, we battle"? Where's the spirit of Pokémon? You still just throw balls at Pokémon until you capture them. Not battle them to lower their HP. You don't battle to raise levels or to even win gym badges. I just don't consider this a "real" Pokémon game. That being said, I think it's a terrific IDEA that we as gamers could really get into. It motivates one to be more active and adventurous. The graphics are okay. Some of the Pokémon look half-assed, like the artists couldn't even bother. I'm also not sure why they don't introduce new Pokémon via generation as their updates progress instead of cherry picked ones. I enjoy the game for what it is and appreciate the effort, but the ball was dropped on this one and I can only hope they'll fix it in the future.

This game contains gambling mechanics aimed at children without revealing the chances to win various prizes. These are all instances I can think of in which real money can be used to get randomly determined items in the game: * Eggs are RANDOMLY determined when gathered, but require incubators, which can be purchased, to "hatch" and be revealed to the player. * Raids give RANDOM items for completion, and only offers a CHANCE to catch. *Pokeballs can be purchased, but only offer a CHANCE to catch a pokemon, whose statistics are RANDOMIZED and UNKNOWN at the time the ball is thrown. *Incense and Lures increase RANDOM spawns at RANDOM intervals, and some lures have pre-set pools from which it chooses, but these pools are not revealed to players. * Rocket Radars are purchasable, and the pokemon the Rocket Boss battle will allow you to catch can be easily determined beforehand, however, the level and hidden stats of the pokemon are unknown until after it has been caught. These mechanics should reveal their probabilities clearly in accordance with the rules about loot boxes and monetized random game mechanics, or be adjusted so that they are no longer completely random, or no longer monetized. Outside of this, the game is ok. Needs a lot of optimization, and the code is apparently completely spaghetti, but it's fun enough.

Pretty game, mainly featuring using your GPS as part of the gameplay. On the downside, it has far too many bugs, problems, etc. Various errors, multiple freezes a day requiring game restart, annoying bugs, that's all about the game. As a popular example: as part of COVID they made free PvP, well, turned out these are often unplayable (just search for "pokemon go weak connection" to understand why; and no, it's unrelated to connection). It is also terribly unoptimized: despite having a simplistic graphics game has far too many moments when it "loads" something. At first I was blaming unoptimized network usage — but no, for my gf with the same network but a newer phone these things load up much faster. That's when I figured, all these moments it indeed calculates something on my phone. To give you an example: friends list, there's nothing to process, really, it's just a menu with a few images, it gotta be instant! Well, turns out it depends on the phone. For an indirect evidence of being badly optimized: it is the most energy-hungry app I've seen so far. There's also a feature of trying to catch pokemon with your camera enabled, but without going into details, you'll most likely disable it quickly. For my gf on her brand new Xiaomi it was wrongly calculating environment, for me in turn pokemon seems not aware of it at all. The world map isn't the most correct one either. So, is it good? Well, for me it was fun to play first 30 hours I think, in part due to quests I have to complete. And I still using it for a friend who I have little other chance to make go out. Other than that, it quickly becomes boring, and the tons of bugs tend to make the game too annoying.

What used to be a 5 star experience is now a 3 star experience. Within the last 6-8 months it'll me an error occurred, cannot login. Within the last 4-6 weeks it's accelerated. I am a longstanding fan of the Pokémon franchise but the catch rates on this game have become a joke. The accuracy of your throw has no bearing to the success of the catch which makes the game extremely frustrating. In a sample of 100 throws, the percentage of successful throws that were not considered "Great, Nice, Excellent", was nearly identical to the percentage of successful throws that had no distinction. As a gamer who values reward for skilled engagement, this is disappointing.

I find it a fun thing to play while wandering around cool places, or even boring places. There is always something new to do, or something to achieve, making it a journey. The only drawbacks are that if you dont have unlimited data it could eat that, and without a good phone it will eat your battery as well.

Overall the app is fun and works really well, but the login page always gives me grief. My login details work but I get the error, unable to verify account all the time. Usually I just close the app, or restart my phone and it fixes it. Sometimes I need to completely reinstall the app and it can still happen.

Very time demanding with optional purchases that can help , although I never spent money in the 5+ years I've been playing. unless you are just playing for fun , you must have some serious time to dedicate to this game if you want to catch em' all. It can be a fun game if your playing casually. Also, catching up time wise can be a struggle. I'm lucky to have been playing since launch, so new players have years to catch up on considering the vast inventory, and their varying stats and abilities.

I honestly enjoy the game but overall free to play players have a tough time in this game for instance you take down a gym and your Pokemon manages to stay there for a long time and collects the max amount of poke coins per day which is 50. With that said people miss out on daily raids and those passes cost 100 coins meaning you can't really enjoy the full extent of the game (shiny, perfect and more)

Genuinely the best of gaming this generation has to offer. I really like the overall concept of the game, as well as many of the mechanics, features that are gradually added overtime, and the abundance of events to partake in. The game provides a great opportunity to combine gaming with going outside for a walk. When visiting a new location or out on a trip, it's especially fun to play this game, as the different stops in the game allow you to notice interesting things in your surroundings that otherwise you might not have realized were there to begin with. While I generally adore the game, I do find the game to be lacking in two regards as well. Firstly, the experience differs greatly between a big city vs. a rural area. Players who live in a rural area, might find their game experience to be lacking, compared to these who can play in a large city. The option to request new stops to be added to the game can combat this issue somewhat, but ultimately the discrepancy remains large. Secondly, the game is often lacking in a variety of QoL aspects. When the player base provides feedback to such matters, only rarely do the game devs make use of this feedback to improve upon the game. While I understand that it is not realistically possible to take the wishes of each individual into account, certain such factors are backed by a large part of the player base, and even so, these requests are not granted, nor compromised on in most cases. To name a few: Decreased incense effectiveness, reduced amount of community day hours, inability to discard eggs, lack of a "ready button" for raids. No option to disable "catch animation". Lacking features to communicate/interact with other players (e.g. to communicate about raids with other nearby players or friends). The game could be a much more amazing experience, if more consideration would be given to such QoL matters.

You can also make the game crash by clicking a gym then hitting x before it completes showing the not needed pictures....you can also do this when it pauses alot to state the obvious on what you caught...like you need to see it tell you three times with a final picture....good gravy. Its not optimized and coding is infantile...again...they could fix 90% of the lag by already having saved data like roads and pokestops you have been to...but no....also you will likely see more common pokemon then ones you want on their search system....its just worse now then before. The battle league is infuriating. The battle system has never been fun or good but making it competitive multiplied its issues significantly. In competitive, only one or two teams and their counters are viable. It's agonizing to get taken out by the same teams over and over again, but when you build a team to counter them you are suddenly paired with a team to counter yours. Maybe I've just run a string of very bad luck, but it's infuriating. I know this ends up being the case in most games, but in a Pokemon game I'd like to be able to diversify my team a little more and be able to shift their moves easily to strategize. You need a specific item to change your moves in game and it doesn't even let you choose what move you will learn. Not to mention to learn a second move, you need a ridiculous amount of in-game resources (stardust and candy). The resource intensive training system makes building teams frustrating and unsatisfying. There is strategy in battles but this broken and twisted version of the Pokemon battle system makes it minimal and largely unfun. And This game was not made for PvP battles and was clearly not made for competitive ranked matches. This battle system works alright for fighting computer-controlled Pokemon in gyms and raids, but its adaptation to PvP has always been lackluster and the decision to make it ranked competitive is baffling. It's understandable that the battle system must be simplified for a mobile Pokemon game in order to make matches quick, but the amount it's been simplified makes them rather boring instead. It's rather disappointing to lose the greater sense of strategy that comes from Pokemon battles, especially since training is a lot more difficult. I want to feel like I don't have to get completely lucky with my catches and hatches to win. I know no game can ever be truly balanced, but I'd like to have more freedom with my moves and team setup. Winning matches is mildly satisfying. Losing is often infuriating. Which brings me to the lag. The entire system lags heavily during PvP matches, causing your Pokemon to completely freeze during battles. Because of the lackluster battle system, timing and response is absolutely crucial. This means that every moment lost from lag can decide the match. The battle system is annoying to me, but the lag multiplies my frustrations tenfold. Now the one star review is a bit of a harsh judgement, but I'm hoping the feedback will encourage Niantic to revamp the PvP battle system. edit: forgot to mention that the team it starts you out with is the team in your last slot, not the team you last played with. This means that if you're not paying attention you can accidentally start with the wrong team

Several research tasks were not completable (you could complete the requirements, but the task would stay on your list, limiting you from picking more up). Reaching out to Niantic resulted in a "We are currently receiving a high volume of requests" notice. Niantic's solution was to send a Remote Raid Pass. 2. 11/14/22 - I had a research task to complete a 3* or higher raid. I successfully completed a Guzzlord raid, which is at 5*, and the task was not completed. Niantic support said that Ultra Beasts did not count for this task, but that "it might get resolved in the future". 3. 1/4/2023 - I started a special Nidorino (with a party hat) raid in person about 3 minutes with a premium raid pass before it despawned. I successfully completed the raid, but the encounter only showed a normal Nidorino. Niantic support said that the special event ended, most likely when the raid had despawned. If you can't catch a special pokemon, why is the option to do the raid even there? Niantic had no solution, but sent a raid pass. And all of these are just problems in PST timezone; I feel bad for New Zealand players, who bear the brunt of new events since they hit all the bugs. (Zorua + raid bugs - not even being able to get into raids) And that's not to mention the recent price boost to remote raids and the remote raid limit that was recently implemented. I struggled to find players to do raids with before and it's not gotten even more difficult to do raids.

Found fix for Nov/2019 update issue. OKAY... So apparently a lot of people are having an issue getting the update to install.
